overview_description.description: KARTY is a Fin-tech platform based in Msheireb, it allows customers to spend, save and manage all of their finances from one-app. It has raised $ 1.2 million in a pre-seed round from Visa, Qatar Development Bank (QDB), Qatar Foundation & Qatar based angel investors. KARTY aims to revolutionize the daily financial experiences for it’s customers by leveraging cutting-edge technology and transaction data. KARTY is working closely with strategic partner "Visa" to deliver full digital payment solutions for both consumer and business expenses.

about_short_description.short_description: KARTY develops a financial management platform that enables customers to spend, save, and manage finances in one application.

product.name: Spending Analytics
product.description: A tool to track and analyze spending habits, helping users identify savings opportunities and make informed financial decisions.

product.name: Personalized Budgeting
product.description: A feature that enables users to create custom budgets, track expenses, and manage financial goals.

product.name: Money Transfer via Mobile Number
product.description: A service to send money quickly and securely to friends or family using only their mobile phone number.

product.name: Expense Splitting
product.description: A feature that allows users to divide shared expenses fairly and automatically among participants.

product.name: Virtual Cards
product.description: Customizable virtual payment cards for secure online shopping and subscription management.

product.name: Rewards Program
product.description: A system that awards KPoints for transactions, which can be redeemed for deals and discounts.
